name: SLIC Superpixel Segmentation with Agglomerative Clustering
definition: A segmentation method for multivariate volumes that generates SLIC superpixels from multivariate voxels and merges them through progressive agglomerative clustering to accurately segment phases/composites.
summary: SLIC Superpixel Segmentation with Agglomerative Clustering segments multivariate volumes by creating local superpixels and merging them via global similarity to accurately group disjointed regions of the same phase.
